Using the identity $1+{cot}^{2}⁡\theta ={csc}^{2}⁡\theta ,$ we rewrite and simplify the expression as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\operatorname{csc}⁡\theta \cdot \operatorname{cot}⁡\theta }{1+{cot}^{2}⁡\theta } & =\frac{\operatorname{csc}⁡\theta \cdot \operatorname{cot}⁡\theta }{{csc}^{2}⁡\theta } \\  & =\frac{1}{\operatorname{csc}⁡\theta }\cdot \operatorname{cot}⁡\theta  \\  & =\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta \cdot \frac{\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta }{\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta } \\  & =\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta \end{aligned}
$$
